messages:
maya: Sharing a short customer-facing runbook I call EchoScan — lightweight warmup + health-check for streaming + cache + batching before go-live. Paste this into a customer enablement doc and we can iterate.

jonas: love it. can you paste steps? :eyes:

maya: 1) quick health checks (latency + 200/500 rates). 2) cache priming (prefix + user profiles) 3) streaming smoke test 4) batching stress 5) telemetry checklist + rollback triggers.

maya: Cache priming example (run from customer or our onboarding job):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prompts":["user: hi\nassistant: ..."],"ttl":86400}'
```

jonas: Good. For streaming, use the simple stream-ping which verifies chunking and keepalive:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=fast-lite&tenant=acme
```

eva: can we include recommended batching params for low‑latency consumer apps? i've seen customers blow up costs.

maya: Suggested defaults:
- max_batch_size=8
- max_wait_ms=30
- enable_prefix_cache=true
- kv_ttl=3600

samir: telemetry to capture: route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, p95_latency, queue_time, batch_size_histogram, cache_hit_rate, streaming_chunk_count. Also record `prefill_id` so we can link warmup to later errors.

maya: Rollback triggers (customer runbook):
- >2x p95 increase vs baseline for 5m
- error rate >3% 2m
- sustained cache_hit_rate <50% after prefill
If triggered: switch to fallback model (same size or smaller) and notify cs+eng: `@oncall`.

oncall-bot: Incident playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-fallback (link)

jonas: i'll make a short one‑pager and push to the enablement folder. can someone review the curl snippets for auth formatting?

eva: i'll proof. also add a short customer-facing explainer about token cost tradeoffs for prefill vs live requests.

maya: thanks. next steps: jonas to draft doc, eva to review, samir to add telemetry keys to onboarding template. tagging @samir @eva. :thumbsup:

samir: got it — I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert. :white_check_mark:

jonas: draft PR created: https://git.internal/docs/runbooks/pull/123

maya: Awesome. landing page note: keep EchoScan under 2k token prefill for cost control.

samir: FYI — prefills can be scheduled during offpeak to reduce contention. recommend 3am-6am job window for big customers.

maya: perfect. closing thread — will attach final doc to tenant onboarding packet.
